notes: Board of Park Commissioners minutes, 1925. Curated: building contracts and park plans.

coverage.remaining: Many meetings postponed for lack of a quorum. Not placed: the Fleishhacker Playfield pool works (bathhouse by Ward & Blohme, boiler house by J. A. Bryant, diving tower by Barrett & Hilp, comfort station by F. R. Siegrist, refreshment stand by George W. Kelham; no page), the Harding Park golf club house by George W. Kelham, the Chamber of Commerce marine lookout at Lands End, the Telegraph Hill balustrade by P. E. Deneville (date unclear), Holly Park basketball courts.
coverage.note: Dated by the date heading over each meeting ('February 5, 1925.'); headings followed by 'postponed' are skipped. Curated list PB1925.py.

findings.description: Willis Polk & Company sent the Board of Park Commissioners sketches of furniture for the new Beach Chalet; the board took no action on them and named two commissioners a committee on its furnishings.

findings.address_as_written: Improvement of Pioneer Park on Telegraph Hill
findings.description: The Board of Park Commissioners authorized Superintendent John McLaren to confer with the architect G. Albert Lansburgh on plans for spending the $10,000 the 1924-25 city budget allotted to beautify Pioneer Park on Telegraph Hill.
